This visualization is a scatter plot analyzing team performance metrics from the NCAA Women's Basketball Data Files 2026, plotting field goal attempts on the horizontal x-axis and points scored on the vertical y-axis. Semi-transparent points (alpha = 0.5) are used to manage point density and overplotting. The layout incorporates a clean minimal theme, clear axis labels, and a descriptive title following Tufte's principles of data-ink optimization.


Function
generate_monte_carlo_points 
Generates a set of random (x, y) coordinates within specified user bounds for a Monte Carlo numerical integration simulation. Parameters - n_points (int) The total sample size (resolution) of random points to generate. - x_bounds (tuple) A tuple containing the (min, max) bounds for the x-axis. - y_bounds (tuple) A tuple containing the (min, max) bounds for the y-axis. Returns - pd.DataFrame A pandas DataFrame containing the generated 'x' and 'y' coordinate columns.

2. Wrangle and tidy the data
Example wrangling workflow join team metadata with game box statistics 
and filter/select key columns for analysis
tidy_ncaa_data <- team_box_data 
  left_join(teams_data, by = "team_id") 
  select(game_id, team_id, team_name, conference, pts, fgm, fga, ast, tov) 
  drop_na()

3. Verify tidy structure
glimpse(tidy_ncaa_data)

library(tidyverse)

1. Load the base CSV files assuming they are in your working directory / R Project
teams_data <- read_csv("teams.csv")
games_data <- read_csv("games.csv")
team_box_data <- read_csv("team_box.csv")

2. Wrangle and tidy the data
Example wrangling workflow join team metadata with game box statistics 
and filter/select key columns for analysis
tidy_ncaa_data <- team_box_data 
  left_join(teams_data, by = "team_id")
  select(game_id, team_id, team_name, conference, pts, fgm, fga, ast, tov) 
  drop_na()

3. Verify tidy structure
glimpse(tidy_ncaa_data)

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

